about.title: About Excell 7 Machine Shop
text: Founded in early 1997 LeeRoy Ivey started Excell 7 Machine Shop with one manual Hollow Spindle Lathe and a goal to build/repair top quality drilling tools with the quickest turnaround in the industry. Since then Excell 7 has grown to house over fourteen CNC machines and eight manual machines in our 21,000 sq. ft. facility located on 10 acres in Houston Texas.
We are proud to be an API Spec 7-1 certified manufacturing facility, which demonstrates our commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
We are committed to delivering exceptional quality and value to our customers, which has resulted in long-standing partnerships with our clients.
